Module com.project.coursework2
Package com.project.coursework2.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.project.coursework2.model.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Staff, Student
public class User extends Object
Domain model representing a system user. A user has a unique ID, display name, role (Student, Staff, or Admin), email, and a cap on concurrent active bookings. Booking history is maintained as an in-memory list and is populated by the data layer on demand.
